title: Babu Frik
franchise: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
description: A Droidsmith, Babu Frik worked with Kijimi Spice Runners like Zorii Bliss. When Poe Dameron sought help on Kijimi, Zorii took Poe  to Babu Frik. Frik adjusted C-3PO's programming so he could translate the Sith language. Poe thought Frik and Zorii died when Kijimi was destroyed. However, they survived and joined the Resistance at the Battle of Exegol.
